goals.name: Mover Training App — Company-Wide Rollout + Driver-Training Port + Digital Training Handbook
goals.assessment: App is live, introduced to the management team at the QGR, and the quarter tracking dashboard is live. The gating milestone is the 8/19 manager sandbox completion: 9 of 23 managers are done company-wide (Leander and San Antonio at 100%; North Austin, Houston, McKinney, Garland, and Tampa still at zero). Managers started logging in and submitting this week and pressure ramps into the deadline. All active movers enroll 8/20; the ≥70% adoption floor shows no red flags yet but is a real reassess point once movers are in the pipeline after the 20th. Managing to Super Green on the training pipeline (full pipeline / Lead-Ready by 10/19); the Scrum recert piece is carved out to the managers' own Scrum goal, so it isn't graded here.
blockers: 8/19 manager sandbox gate at 9/23 complete with 5 branches (N. Austin, Houston, McKinney, Garland, Tampa) still at zero
goals.superGreen: Mgr sandbox 100% by 8/19 + movers 100% enrolled 8/20 + ≥70% through full pipeline (Lead-Ready) by 10/19 + Scrum recert by 10/19
goals.green: Mgr sandbox 100% by 8/19 + movers 100% enrolled 8/20 + ≥70% through stage 4 by EOQ

goals.name: Dept-Head/Regional Split — FDE Boots-on-Ground Weeks + Dept-Head QGs as Critical Number
goals.assessment: Tracking to Super Green: all 5 field weeks are scheduled starting next week (Green is 3, SG is 5). The enabling infrastructure is already live — the full DFWT command center gives a weekly KPI dashboard + composite score reviewed with the branches each week, which drives focus during each visit and sets priority if things shift mid-quarter. Key-issue logging runs through the Road-to-A+ HQ + command center, so capturing and tracking the 1-issue-per-visit requirement is easy and trackable. The main risk is non-goal workload pulling Mike off the process and out of the field weeks.
blockers: Non-goal workload is the primary risk to staying engaged across all 5 visit weeks

milestones.name: Project HQ + Branch Visit Tour built + all 5 visits scheduled

goals.green: 3 FDE field weeks across the 10 branches by Oct 1 + 1 key issue/visit logged and resolved or on a documented action plan

goals.name: Fleet Safety Pt 3 — Carry the Red, Restructured
goals.assessment: Honest red and an uphill quarter. Company came in at 86 in week 1 — down from last quarter — and this week's score is still being finalized. A structural headwind: Einstein Games is not live this quarter, removing the main lever that kept the team engaged on safety. The restructure centers on the warning chase, and this is the first week the chase list is being confirmed — whether last week's required warnings were actually issued in Rippling lands today or tomorrow, so chase effectiveness is still unproven. Mike's honest read: this is a fight all quarter to reach Green (≥90 by Oct 1 + zero warning backlog), let alone Super Green.
blockers: Company Samsara score under 90 and trending down from last quarter
Einstein Games not live this quarter — lost the primary team-engagement lever
Warning-chase effectiveness unproven until this week's first confirmation

goals.name: Sell Remaining Trucks + Fund 2026 Fleet Purchases
goals.assessment: Aiming to sell all 5 but managing to the Green line of 3. Path to the first sale: the NWT truck is prepped and spoken for, blocked on a check-engine fix that's being worked now; the rest need good photos, then they get posted to Facebook Marketplace to gauge engagement. No buyer-side deadline pressure — Oct 31 (EOQ) is the only clock. Funds the 2026 fleet purchases.
blockers: NWT truck check-engine fix (in progress) must clear before the first sale closes
Remaining trucks need photos before posting to Marketplace

milestones.name: Remaining trucks photographed + posted to Marketplace

goals.name: Manager Training App — SOP Sandbox Training and reference
goals.assessment: Aiming for Super Green (7-8 modules). The project HQ is built, the list of core trainings is defined, and the build order is set. The first module (Samsara Management) is in build now. Pace is the whole game: one module every two weeks gets to the 7-8 set by Oct 31 — tight but workable. Nothing structural is blocking (no tooling or ownership gaps); the only risk is holding that every-other-week cadence.
blockers: No modules deployed yet; hitting the set depends on holding a 1-module-every-2-weeks cadence
